happened: Group Wade built an AI agent that wakes on an email notification, reads phone number, client name, and team name, uses Email, Call Transcript, and CRM, matches the caller to an existing client, matches the client to the representing team, summarizes the call and what is requested, then forwards the voicemail and summary to that team.
why: Container, tools, trigger, inputs, skills, and action all match the warmup best board.

skills: Match the caller to an existing client
Match the client to the Team that best represents them
Summarize the call and what is requested
board.action: Forward voicemail and a summary of the call request to the representing team
